Subject: MAP: Vendor Onboarding & Procurement Steps — ACME Corp

Hi Jamie — great to speak earlier today. Per our call, I'm sharing a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the vendor onboarding / procurement milestones so we can align on owners and target dates. The key milestone you flagged was vendor onboarding into Ariba (or Coupa) and completing tax/banking paperwork.

Attached: redwood_MAP_draft.xlsx (Excel, 45 KB)

Summary / next steps (high level):
- Milestone: Vendor registration in Ariba/Coupa — owner: ACME procurement (Jamie) / Redwood (Marissa) for fields we provide. Target: 2026-08-05
- Milestone: Vendor Forms (W-9, insurance cert, vendor questionnaire) — owner: Redwood to provide W-9 and completed vendor questionnaire; ACME to accept/ingest — Target: 2026-08-03
- Milestone: Banking details & remittance setup — owner: ACME procurement to supply vendor banking form; Redwood to provide bank verification via secure DocuSign — Target: 2026-08-10
- Dependencies: Ariba/Coupa vendor ID needed for purchase orders; SOC2 evidence and SOW signature occur in parallel.

Can you confirm: (1) whether ACME will onboard via Ariba or Coupa (we can support both); (2) the internal contact for Accounts Payable if different from this thread; and (3) whether the target close of onboarding by 2026-08-10 is feasible?

If useful, Rafael can join procurement calls to expedite technical questions about our tax/banking docs.

Thanks — I'll update the MAP after your reply.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the recap and the MAP, Marissa. A few quick items from our side:

1) We use Ariba for vendor onboarding. If you can provide the standard vendor XML/CSV fields or tell us which tabs to expect in the MAP, that will speed things.

2) I'm the procurement lead for this engagement but AP is a separate team (cc'd procurement@acmecorp.com). They'll want the W-9 and vendor banking form. Do you accept bank info via DocuSign or do you require a secure portal?

3) Timeline: Ariba setup + W-9 typically takes 7-10 business days once we have all docs. If you can get the W-9 and the supplier banking form back to us by 2026-07-28, I think a target onboarding date of 2026-08-10 is realistic.

Questions for clarification: who from Redwood completes the Ariba registration fields (vendor tax ID, remittance address, NAICS codes, etc.)? Also, do you have a standard payee name to enter (we'll need exact legal name for PO)?

Best,
Jamie
